sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2004
ACT VII OF 2004
BALOCHISTAN
ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975 (II
of 1975)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 19th August, 2004]
No.PAB/:Legis:V(13)/2004,
dated 19-8-2804.--The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and
Allowances) (Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Balochistan on 10th August, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Assembly Members
(Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) it shall come into force at
once.

ACT VII OF 2004
ACT VII OF 2004
BALOCHISTAN
ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975 (II
of 1975)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 19th August, 2004]
No.PAB/:Legis:V(13)/2004,
dated 19-8-2804.--The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and
Allowances) (Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Balochistan on 10th August, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Insertion of new sections 7-F
and 7-G in Act II of 1975.--In the Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries
and Allowances) Act 1975, after section 7-E, the following new sections shall
be inserted namely:--
"7-F. Official
Residence for the Leader of Opposition.--The Leader of Opposition shall
be provided an official residence otherwise he shall be entitled to draw House
Rent Allowance at the rate of fifteen thousand rupees per mensem.
7-G. Official Vehicle for
the Leader of Opposition.--An official vehicle shall be provided to the
Leader of Opposition and he shall also be entitled to draw five thousand rupees
per month as POL Allowance with Salary.
